title: Things to ask
content:
# Things to ask

Requests that work well once Zernio is connected to your AI assistant, for posting, scheduling, replying to DMs and comments, analytics and ads.

Once Zernio is [connected](/for-you/mcp), ask in plain language. Click a request to copy it.

Name the platform and, if you have several accounts there, which one.

## Post and schedule

<PromptList
  items={[
    { prompt: "Post \"We're open this Saturday 10am–4pm\" to Instagram and LinkedIn now." },
    { prompt: "Schedule this for tomorrow at 9am New York time on X: ..." },
    { prompt: "Save this as a draft for my Facebook page, I'll review it later." },
    { prompt: "Show my scheduled posts for next week." },
    { prompt: "Move my next LinkedIn post to Friday at noon." },
    { prompt: "Which posts failed? Retry them." },
  ]}
/>

## Write with you

<PromptList
  items={[
    { prompt: "Turn this blog post into a LinkedIn post and a short X thread, then schedule both for Monday." },
    { prompt: "Write three caption options for this product photo, keep them under 150 characters." },
  ]}
/>

## Inbox

<PromptList
  items={[
    { prompt: "Show my unanswered Instagram DMs from this week." },
    { prompt: "Summarize the new comments on my last YouTube video." },
    { prompt: "Reply to the latest message from Ana: \"Thanks! We'll ship it Monday.\"" },
  ]}
/>

## Analytics

<PromptList
  items={[
    { prompt: "How did my Instagram posts do last month? Which one got the most engagement?" },
    { prompt: "Compare my LinkedIn and X reach for the last 30 days." },
  ]}
/>

## Ads

<PromptList
  items={[
    { prompt: "List my active Meta ad campaigns and what they spent this week." },
    { prompt: "Pause the campaign with the lowest click-through rate." },
  ]}
/>

## Tips

- **Check before publishing.** Ask for a draft first, read it, then say "publish it".
- **Several accounts on one platform?** Say which one ("my @acme account"). The assistant asks if it's unsure.
- **Images and videos** need one extra step. See [post images and videos](/for-you/media).
- **Platform rules still apply.** Each [supported platform](/for-you/platforms) has its own character and media limits.
